title: Group Weddings
notConnectedYet: Group weddings will be built in P10.

discovery.title: Group weddings
discovery.subtitle: Organize a shared wedding in your area with transparent cost splitting, and no financial intermediation.
discovery.publicNote: Cards show only the name, area, participant count and approximate month. Member names are visible to members only.
discovery.demoNote: Every group here is demo data and does not represent real people.
discovery.emptyDescription: Create a new group or widen the filters. You can populate demo data from developer settings.
discovery.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching groups. Please retry.
discovery.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

create.title: Create a wedding group
create.subtitle: Three short steps. No amount and no card data are requested.

help.alternateDate: Optional; used in voting if the first date does not work.
help.description: Optional. Do not include phone numbers or personal data.

create.consent: I accept the group's approved withdrawal policy.
create.policyNote: Withdrawal is allowed until {{days}} days before the date. This window is provisional and awaits owner approval.
create.maxNote: Maximum group size: {{max}} (provisional value from system settings).

detail.title: Group
detail.publicNote: You are not a member; you see the public summary only. Send a join request to see details.
detail.joinConsent: I agree to show my display name to group members only.
detail.budgetComing: Budget and agreement ship in the next part of P10.
detail.withdrawWindowOpen: You are inside the withdrawal window. Costs will be re-split across remaining members once the budget is adopted.
detail.withdrawWindowClosed: The withdrawal window has closed; your withdrawal is recorded and costs are re-split, and your future priority may be affected.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this group. It may have been deleted or the link is invalid.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Names are visible to group members only, and with the owner's consent.
members.emptyDescription: Join requests will appear here for review.
members.rejectReason: The request does not currently meet the group's conditions.

polls.title: Voting
polls.subtitle: One vote per participant, changeable until the deadline.
polls.emptyDescription: The organizer or a co-organizer creates polls for the date, venue and more.
polls.notMember: Voting is limited to active group members.
polls.resultsNote: Results are live and never produce a binding decision; the final agreement is signed by members.

reasons.open: Voting is still open; no final result before the deadline.
reasons.quorumNotMet: Quorum was not met, so no result is adopted.
reasons.tieOrganizer: Tie, resolved by the organizer's vote.
reasons.tieOrder: Tie, resolved by the declared option order.

reasons.groupEmpty: No members remain; costs are not assigned to anyone.

blocked.image: Images are not allowed in the organizational chat.
blocked.link: Links are not allowed in the organizational chat.
blocked.phone: Phone numbers are not allowed; protect privacy.
blocked.rate: Please slow down before sending another message.
blocked.notMember: Chat is limited to active members.
blocked.muted: You have been temporarily muted by the organizer.

invite.title: Wedding group invitation
invite.body: You were invited to join a group wedding.

joinApproved.title: Your request was approved
joinApproved.body: You are now a member of the wedding group.

poll.title: New poll
poll.body: A poll was added to the wedding group; you can vote until the deadline.

validation.title: Enter a group name (at least 3 characters).
validation.targetCount: The target count must be within the allowed range.
validation.targetMax: The count exceeds the maximum group size.
validation.withdrawalConsent: Accepting the withdrawal policy is required.
validation.message: Write a short message to the organizer.
validation.displayNameConsent: Consent to show your display name to members is required.
validation.question: Write the poll question.
validation.label: Write a label for the item.
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
